rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Security Framework combines NIST and OWASP data sources into a unified MCP server providing over 4,700 security data points. NIST coverage includes SP 800-53 controls (1,196 items) and CSF 2.0 (225 items), while OWASP data spans 418 projects, ASVS 5.0, WSTG, Top 10 lists, MASVS, 815+ CWEs, and 559 CAPEC patterns. Live APIs provide NVD/CVE vulnerability data, CISA KEV, and EPSS scores. The 41 tools support security search, control retrieval, vulnerability triage, compliance mapping, threat modeling, and stack assessment.
